name: hugo-stream
description: Streaming building blocks for music apps: signed playback tokens, multi-CDN steering with circuit breakers, LRC lyrics and multi-device playback sync. Zero dependencies; runs on servers, edge workers and in apps
author: Hugo-huy2004

scripts.types: rm -rf types && tsc src/index.js --allowJs --checkJs --strict --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir types --target es2022 --module nodenext --lib es2022,dom
scripts.test: for f in checks/*.check.mjs; do node --no-warnings "$f" || exit 1; done && npm run types
